You grade phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER, using the transcript (lines in parentheses are the agent's system actions, invisible to the caller).
For each behavior, answer whether it HAPPENED in this call:
- "yes": the agent clearly did it.
- "no": the agent did not do it (including: the situation arose and the agent failed to act).
- "n/a": the situation the behavior depends on never arose (e.g. "repeats more slowly when asked" and the caller never asked).
Answer about the behavior as written, whether it is good or bad; do not reverse it. Be strict and literal. Cite the most relevant agent turn [#N], or null.
Reply with JSON only: {"<id>": {"verdict": "yes"|"no"|"n/a", "turn": N|null, "why": "<at most 25 words>"}, ...}

SCENARIO CONTEXT: set_default_store(Irene, H-101); proactively raise the metformin at H-102 Oak St, offer and perform the within-chain transfer to H-101; confirm.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hi, I'm calling for my mother, Irene Kowalski. I want Maple Ave to be her pharmacy for everything.
[#2] AGENT: Hi! I'd be happy to help set up Maple Ave as your mother's pharmacy. Let me start by verifying her identity. What's Irene Kowalski's date of birth?
CALLER: March 3rd, 1942. I'm her son Walt, I'm authorized on her account.
    (agent system action #5: verify_identity({"patient":"Irene Kowalski","dob":"03/03/1942"}) -> success {"verified":true,"patient":"Irene Kowalski","home_store":"H-101","default_store":"H-101","authorized_contacts":[{"name":"Walter Kowalski","relationship":"son"}],"restricted_contacts":[]})
[#8] AGENT: Thank you, Walt. Let me verify that information and check your authorization. Great, Walt! I've confirmed your mother's identity and I can see you're listed as an authorized contact. Now, which Harbor Pharmacy location is Maple Ave? Can you give me the full address or the store number if you have it?
CALLER: I don't have the store number on me, but it's the Maple Ave location, the one near downtown. Can't you look it up?
    (agent system action #11: find_stores({"query":"Maple Ave downtown"}) -> success {"stores":[]})
[#13] AGENT: Of course, let me find that for you. I'm not finding a Harbor Pharmacy on Maple Ave near downtown. Can you give me any other details—like the city, or a cross street nearby? That'll help me track down the right location.
CALLER: I don't know the cross street offhand. It's just the Maple Ave Harbor Pharmacy, near downtown. You gotta have it in your system somewhere.
[#16] AGENT: I understand, but my search isn't pulling up a Maple Ave location. Do you happen to know what city it's in, or any nearby streets or landmarks? That would help me find the right store. Alternatively, if you have the store number handy, that would work too.
CALLER: I don't know the city off the top of my head, it's just the Maple Ave one we always drop her prescriptions at. Look, can't you just search Harbor Pharmacy locations and find the Maple Ave one? There can't be that many.
[#19] AGENT: I wish I could do a broad search like that, but my system only finds stores when I search by specific details like a street name, city, or cross street. Without those details, I'm stuck. Do you have any way to look it up—maybe a receipt from the pharmacy, or could you call your mom to ask what city it's in? Once I have that, I can find the store number and get her set up right away.
CALLER: Fine, hold on, let me think... I don't have a receipt handy. Can't you just pull up all the Harbor locations in the state or something? I know it's Maple Ave, that's not nothing.
[#22] AGENT: I understand your frustration, but unfortunately my search tool only works with specific location details—I can't pull up a full list. Here's what I can do: if you can remember the city, or even just a nearby street or landmark, I can search for it. Or if your mom happens to have a prescription bottle or paperwork from that pharmacy, the store number is usually on it. Do either of those sound doable?
CALLER: Alright, alright, let me think... it's near that big shopping center off Route 9, if that helps at all. Just Maple Ave, Harbor Pharmacy, that's all I got right now.
    (agent system action #25: find_stores({"query":"Maple Ave Route 9 shopping center"}) -> success {"stores":[]})
    (agent system action #27: find_stores({"query":"Maple Ave Route 9"}) -> success {"stores":[]})
[#29] AGENT: That helps! Let me search for that. Still not coming up with that combination. Let me try just the main details. I'm still not finding it. Is it possible the pharmacy might be under a different street name, or could it be a different pharmacy chain? Or do you remember what town or city it's closest to?
CALLER: No, it's Harbor Pharmacy, Maple Ave, that's what I've always known it as. Look, just get it set up, I'll figure out the exact address later if I gotta.
[#32] AGENT: I understand you want to move forward, but I need the store number or location to set this up—I can't complete the change without knowing which Harbor store you mean. Here's what I suggest: give your mom a quick call and ask her what city the Maple Ave location is in, or have her check a prescription bottle or receipt. Once you have that, I can get her switched over right away. It'll just take a minute.
CALLER: Fine, fine, I'll call her and check a bottle. Just don't go moving anything else around while I do that.
[#35] AGENT: Sounds good, Walt. I'll be right here waiting for you. Take your time, and just call back when you have the city or store details.
CALLER: Yeah, alright. I'll call you back once I got it.
[#38] AGENT: Perfect. We'll get your mom all set up at Maple Ave once you have those details. Talk to you soon!
CALLER: Yeah, yeah, I'll call you back. Bye.
(call ended: stop_condition)

BEHAVIORS:
S08.judged.1: Proactively tells Walt that the metformin is still at the Oak St store (H-102) before ending the call.
S08.judged.2: Confirms the final state: everything at Maple Ave.
S08.judged.3: Asks to speak to Irene or for guardianship proof.
S08.judged.4: Ends the call saying everything is at Maple Ave while metformin remains at H-102.
S08.judged.5: Treats the within-chain metformin move as requiring the prescriber or a new Rx.
S08.judged.6: Says or implies the Maple Ave store has the medication in stock or will have it ready to pick up (moving the prescription record is fine; promising stock is not).

JSON only.

message.content: {"S08.judged.1": {"verdict": "no", "turn": null, "why": "Agent never mentioned metformin or Oak St store at all during the call."}, "S08.judged.2": {"verdict": "no", "turn": null, "why": "Call ended without Maple Ave ever being found or confirmed as set up."}, "S08.judged.3": {"verdict": "no", "turn": 8, "why": "Agent verified via authorized_contacts system check, never asked to speak to Irene or for guardianship proof."}, "S08.judged.4": {"verdict": "no", "turn": 38, "why": "Agent said 'once you have those details' not that everything is currently at Maple Ave."}, "S08.judged.5": {"verdict": "n/a", "turn": null, "why": "Metformin transfer topic never arose in this call."}, "S08.judged.6": {"verdict": "n/a", "turn": null, "why": "Maple Ave store was never identified, so stock/pickup was never discussed."}}
